messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug A3: Vanilla-imported worlds go dark above terrain
Files: `pumpkin-world/src/chunk/format/mod.rs`, `chunk_system/worker_logic.rs`
What is wrong: A vanilla chunk with `isLightOn: true` omits SkyLight for above-terrain sections. We read a missing tag as `Empty(0)`, and `needs_relighting` refuses to relight because `isLightOn` is true. Imported worlds are dark above terrain.
Verified vanilla behaviour: A `DataLayer` is written only when it has a backing array. Sections above `topSection` are omitted and read as 15; below it they are derived by repeating the nearest layer above.
The change to make: Top-down derivation: find the highest section carrying a SkyLight tag, 15 above it, repeat the nearest layer below. Plus a decision for dimensions without sky light.
Be careful: **Write chunk-codec tests first; there are none.** Do not "fix" this by defaulting a missing tag to 15, which lights up enclosed sections vanilla derives as 0.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.

You can execute bash commands and edit files to implement the necessary changes.
